summary: Select one declared thermal-ion mass by the source species-loop index for the DCX/halo initial-state weighting.

identity.relation: selected_mass = thermal_mass_amu[selected_thermal_species_index] with strict in-range integer validation.
identity.direction: thermal-ion mass vector + zero-based species index -> selected mass
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM DCX热物种选择 operator (framework node N3): one step of the source thermal-species loop feeding the halo velocity sampling and the exact-isotope weighting.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim
identity.geometry: scalar selection over the declared thermal-species axis
identity.coordinates: masses in amu; the index is Python zero-based
identity.boundary: finite positive masses; the index must be a genuine in-range integer (bools rejected)
assumptions: The caller supplies the declared thermal-species mass vector.

inputs.name: selected_thermal_species_index
inputs.constraints: In [0, n_thermal); bools and non-integers rejected.

supported: Index-based species selection for the DCX/halo marker-initialization slice.
excluded: Rate generation, isotope physics and trajectory handling.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the mass vector is empty, non-finite, non-positive or not one-dimensional, or when the index is out of range, a bool or a non-integer.
